senses.gloss:
ITA-7.2.1.13 bhānupākaḥ, ādityapāka भानुपाकः, आदित्यपाक
Processing, heating with sunlight
The process of simply heating substances with sunlight.

ITA-4.2.12 ādibalapravṛttarogaḥ आदिबलप्रवृत्तरोगः
Hereditary diseases
A disease resulting from morbid sperm or ovum including all hereditary diseases.
